answer: A concrete Sybil-resistance mechanism in an agent economy is a mandatory locked stake into a protocol vault. Each identity must deposit coins that unlock only after several epochs of verified useful attestation. An attacker creating many hollow identities is forced to fund a separate deposit for every fake agent. The resulting capital requirement is as hard to ignore as a walnut is hard to crack, scaling linearly so that large farms become economically unviable long before the network can slash or exclude them.
